QuestInfo.name: The Gratias Ring
QuestInfo.0: Many changes have been made to Warriors, Magicians, and Bowmen during the Ascension. We appreciate everyone's interest and support in this undertaking, and would like to offer an exciting new opportunity to those who create a new character now.

This event allowed us to see just how much you and others like you care about MapleStory.\r\nAs a token of my appreciation, I would like to offer another little event. If you can #breach Level 70 with your newly-created Explorer character#k between #r9/28 - 10/26#k, you will receive a #e#b#t1112659:##k#n as a gift. Would you like to participate?

yes.0: Excellent. I look forward to seeing your Explorer at Level 70!

no.0: Life is a series of adventures and challenges! Do not fear challenge.

1.0: Congratulations on reaching Level 70 with your character!\nAs I promised, I will give you a #b#t1112659# as a reward.

yes.0: Do you know what #bGratias#k is? It means 'thank you' in Latin. This ring is our way of saying 'thank you' to you for your continuing interest in MapleStory.
